webhooks.detail: Webhook subscriptions (UI and public API) for 6 events: CONTACT_CREATED, CONTACT_TAG_ADDED, CONTACT_TAG_REMOVED, CONTACT_OPT_IN, SALE_NEW, SALE_CANCELED. HMAC-SHA256 signature, up to 12 retries, max 10 webhooks per account.

evidence.quote: Currently, users can create a maximum of 10 webhooks in one account.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox or test mode in the docs read. Free plan and pricing were not checked. API keys are created in Settings (max 3 per account).

evidence.quote: You can create up to 3 API keys per account.

rate_limits.summary: Rate limiting documented (X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Refill headers, 429 + Retry-After); no numeric quota published

evidence.quote: Our Public API implements a rate-limiting system to maintain service stability and availability for all users.
